title: The Ginger Barista

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up macro, vertical framing centered: a fluffy ginger paw with soft white toe tufts grips the polished copper lever of a chrome espresso machine and yanks it down hard in the first second. A thick burst of white steam explodes upward through a low beam of golden sunrise light raking in from frame left, the vapor glowing honey-gold, dust motes swirling. The camera pulls back slowly and racks focus as the steam thins, and out of the drifting cloud emerges the face of the fluffy ginger tabby cat barista with bright amber eyes, white chest fur and a tiny brown linen apron, centered in frame. His whiskers twitch, his ears flick back at the noise, then his amber eyes narrow in serious concentration as he stares straight into the lens. The setting is a tiny cozy corner café at sunrise with a worn oak counter and sage-green tiles, a warm pendant bulb softly glowing in the creamy bokeh behind him. Very shallow depth of field, fine 35mm film grain, deep espresso browns and polished copper highlights. Sound: a sharp metallic clack of the lever, an explosive close-miked steam hiss that rises and fades into a bubbling espresso gurgle, faint morning birdsong outside the window, and a short low determined chirp from the cat.
shots.caption: Кофейня открывается в 6:00
shots.beat: Макро: рыжая лапа с силой тянет рычаг эспрессо-машины, взрыв пара в первом солнечном луче, из облака проступает серьёзная морда кота-бариста (подпись: «Кофейня открывается в 6:00»)
shots.foley: a sharp metallic clack of an espresso lever, a loud burst of steam fading into bubbling espresso, faint birdsong outside

shots.prompt: Low-angle medium close-up across the worn oak counter, vertical framing centered, 85mm feel with very shallow depth of field: the fluffy ginger tabby cat barista with bright amber eyes, white chest fur and a tiny brown linen apron holds a small polished copper milk pitcher in both paws beneath the chrome steam wand of the espresso machine. Inside the pitcher, cream-white milk swirls in a tight whirlpool and froths up toward the rim. His ears twitch and flick with each shrill burst of steam, his whiskers tremble, and his amber eyes stay locked on the swirling milk as he tilts the pitcher slightly. The camera slowly pushes in toward his face and the pitcher. A low beam of golden sunrise light from the tall window at frame left creeps across the oak counter, reaches the rising steam and sets it glowing honey-gold, copper flaring with warm highlights against sage-green tiles in soft bokeh. Fine 35mm film grain. Sound: a rising high-pitched milk-steaming squeal, the soft roar of swirling foam, a faint metal tick of the warming pitcher, distant birdsong, and a low steady purr under it all.
shots.caption: Бариста — профессионал
shots.beat: Кот держит медный питчер под паровой трубкой, молоко шипит и закручивается, уши подрагивают, солнечный луч медленно ползёт по стойке и зажигает пар
shots.foley: a milk steaming wand roaring in a metal pitcher, swirling foam, a metal pitcher tick, distant birdsong

shots.prompt: Top-down overhead close-up, vertical framing with a round cream ceramic cup centered on the worn oak counter: the cup holds dark espresso with a glossy hazel-brown crema. The spout of a polished copper pitcher enters from above, held by a fluffy ginger paw with soft white toe tufts, and a thin silky stream of steamed milk falls into the center. White foam blooms outward across the crema in a widening circle. The paw lowers the pitcher closer and rocks it gently side to side, and soft layered ripples spread across the surface, then the paw lifts and draws the stream straight through, pulling the white shape into a perfect symmetrical heart. The camera holds static, then drifts down slightly toward the finished heart. Low golden sunrise light rakes from frame left, gilding the rim of the cup and casting a long soft shadow, faint steam curling up glowing in the beam, fine 35mm film grain. Sound: a soft continuous liquid pour, a gentle glug as the stream thickens, a delicate clink of copper against the ceramic rim, then a quiet pleased trill from the cat and a deep rumbling purr.
shots.caption: Секретный ингредиент — любовь
shots.beat: Сверху: тонкая струя молока падает в эспрессо, пенка расходится, лапа покачивает питчер, и на поверхности проступает идеальное сердце
shots.foley: a continuous liquid pour into a ceramic cup, a gentle glug, a clink of copper on the rim, a deep cat purr

shots.prompt: Low-angle medium shot from behind the worn oak counter, vertical framing, 50mm feel with very shallow depth of field. In the foreground, the fluffy ginger tabby cat barista with bright amber eyes, white chest fur and a tiny brown linen apron sits beside a cream ceramic cup, head bowed over it. In the soft background, a glass café door swings open and a brass bell above it jolts and rings. The sleepy young woman with messy auburn hair in a chunky cream knitted scarf and a mustard wool coat steps into the centered doorway, wrapped in a halo of golden sunrise backlight, and rubs one eye with her sleeve. The cat's ears swivel toward the sound, then he lifts his head and turns his amber eyes to her as focus racks from his fur to the doorway. Honey-gold rim light on her hair and his whiskers, floating dust glittering, sage-green tiles in creamy bokeh, fine 35mm film grain. Sound: a bright brass bell jingle, the creak of the door hinge, a waft of birdsong from outside, her soft sleepy sigh, then a warm chirping meow and a low welcoming purr from the cat.
shots.caption: Первый гость
shots.beat: Звякает колокольчик, в дверях в золотом свете появляется сонная девушка в вязаном шарфе, кот поднимает голову и приветственно мурлыкает (подпись: «Первый гость»)
shots.foley: a brass door bell jingling, a creaking door hinge, birdsong from outside, footsteps on a wooden floor

shots.prompt: Medium close-up at counter height, vertical framing centered on the sleepy young woman with messy auburn hair in a chunky cream knitted scarf and a mustard wool coat, leaning on the worn oak counter. A fluffy ginger paw with white toe tufts slides a cream ceramic cup toward her, the white foam heart wobbling on the crema. She glances down, freezes for a beat, and a slow smile spreads across her face; she looks up and whispers in Russian in a warm, husky morning voice: "Спасибо, Рыжик." She lifts the cup with both hands and takes a small sip. A hard cut to a close-up of the fluffy ginger tabby cat barista with bright amber eyes, white chest fur and a tiny brown linen apron: he squeezes his eyes shut in a long contented blink, chin raised, as thin steam curls up glowing in the foreground and the camera slowly pushes into the steam. Low golden sunrise light from frame left, honey-gold fur, copper bokeh, fine 35mm film grain. Sound: a soft ceramic scrape on oak, her gentle whisper, a quiet sip, then across the cut a deep rumbling purr and the faint hiss of the espresso machine.
shots.caption: Утро удалось
shots.beat: Кот подталкивает чашку, девушка видит сердце на пенке, улыбается, шепчет «Спасибо, Рыжик», делает глоток; кот довольно жмурится, над чашкой вьётся пар — петля к началу (подпись: «Утро удалось»)
shots.foley: a ceramic cup sliding on an oak counter, a quiet sip, a deep rumbling cat purr, cozy cafe room tone

logline: At dawn in a tiny café, a ginger cat barista works his magic on a latte for the first customer, and his foam heart makes someone's morning.
synopsis: Первый луч солнца падает на стойку крошечной кофейни, и рыжая лапа решительно тянет рычаг эспрессо-машины, выпуская облако пара. Рыжий кот-бариста в коричневом фартуке взбивает молоко, его уши подрагивают от шипения, а золотой свет заливает медный питчер. Он сосредоточенно вливает молоко в чашку, и на пенке медленно проступает сердце. Звякает колокольчик над дверью: входит сонная девушка в вязаном шарфе. Кот подталкивает к ней чашку, она видит сердце на пенке, расплывается в улыбке и делает глоток, а кот довольно жмурится.

style.visual: a tiny wood-and-brass corner café at sunrise, photographed like a warm handcrafted live-action film with real fur, real steam and real foam, cozy cinematic realism
style.palette: honey-gold sunlight on surfaces and fur, warm cream of milk foam and ceramic, deep espresso brown for wood, coffee and the apron, polished copper highlights, soft sage-green accents on tiles and plants
style.lens: 50mm to 85mm feel, very shallow depth of field, creamy circular bokeh from window light, fine 35mm film grain, visible steam and floating dust in the light
style.lighting: low golden sunrise light raking through a single side window from frame left, long soft shadows, backlit steam glowing, warm 3200K practical glow from a small pendant bulb as fill
style.camera: close and intimate, slow push-ins and gentle handheld drift, top-down inserts for coffee details, motivated small moves only, subjects kept centered for vertical framing
style.sound: crisp close-miked café ASMR: espresso machine hiss and gurgle, milk steaming squeal, ceramic clinks, liquid pours, a brass door bell, soft cat purring and chirps, faint birdsong outside; a gentle lo-fi acoustic bed added later
style.pace: brisk but cozy: 5-7 second shots joined by hard cuts, each cut lands on a sound accent (hiss, clink, bell), calm final beat that loops back to the steam

characters.name: Рыжик
characters.descriptor: the fluffy ginger tabby cat barista with bright amber eyes, white chest fur and a tiny brown linen apron
characters.description: Серьёзный, сосредоточенный рыжий кот, стоящий за стойкой как настоящий мастер. Работает лапами точно и важно, гордится каждой чашкой и тает от благодарности.
characters.voice: no human speech; soft chirping meows, a short pleased trill and deep rumbling purr

characters.name: Первая посетительница
characters.descriptor: the sleepy young woman with messy auburn hair in a chunky cream knitted scarf and a mustard wool coat
characters.description: Девушка лет двадцати пяти, заходит до работы, ещё не проснулась. Её улыбка при виде рисунка на пенке и есть развязка истории.
characters.voice: Young woman in her mid-twenties, warm soft slightly husky alto, sleepy unhurried morning delivery with a smile in the voice, speaking quietly close to the microphone

locations.name: Крошечная кофейня на рассвете
locations.descriptor: a tiny cozy corner café at sunrise with a worn oak counter, a polished copper-and-chrome espresso machine, sage-green tiles, hanging plants and a single tall window pouring golden morning light

music.mood: gentle lo-fi acoustic morning tune: fingerpicked nylon guitar, soft marimba and brushed light percussion, warm and smiling, unhurried, about 85 bpm, rising slightly into the final reveal

request: Тестовый шортс: рыжий кот-бариста в крошечной кофейне на рассвете готовит латте. Пар над чашкой, первые лучи солнца через окно, уютное тёплое настроение. В конце довольный первый посетитель получает чашку с рисунком на пенке.

sound.score_prompt: gentle lo-fi acoustic morning tune, fingerpicked nylon guitar, soft marimba, brushed light percussion, warm and smiling, unhurried, rising slightly at the end
